title: Anti-Müllerian hormone level predicted effector genes (Verdiesen RMG et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genome-wide association study meta-analysis identifies three novel loci for circulating anti-Müllerian hormone levels in women.
Verdiesen RMG, et al.
Hum Reprod. 2022 May 3;37(5):1069-1082. doi: 10.1093/humrep/deac028.
PMID: 35274129

The authors performed a GWAS for circulating anti-Müllerian hormone (AMH) levels in 7,049 premenopausal females of European ancestry. AMH is produced by antral stage ovarian follicles in women and can be used as a marker for reproductive aging.  They then applied the FUMA GWAS pipeline and the DEPICT algorithm to prioritize variants and genes at the GWAS loci. 

The table below includes the genes prioritized by DEPICT. Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.
